method: MHM CPU native workspace and dedicated GPU-process condensation

gpu_worker_metadata.name: NVIDIA RTX A5000
gpu_worker_metadata.memory_note: Boundary observations, not an estimate of factorization peak memory.
gpu_worker_metadata.resource_ownership: one resident spawn process per physical GPU; fresh matrix-dependent factors/hierarchy for each macrocell
gpu_worker_metadata.return_payload: source/lifts/executed coarse_vectors only; original input CSR/B/f/Z/C remain in parent

reuse_scope: native FEM resources and proven geometry-only B/C; no material-dependent operator/factor/response reuse
pipeline_scope: CPU assembly pool completes before GPU actors; no overlap is implied
timed_inclusions: all source/trace/retained RHS and original residual checks
parent_startup_timing_convention: External launcher wall-clock epoch includes parent process/imports; explicitly timed JIT warmup, when requested, is excluded. Without an external epoch parent startup is not measured.

executed_state.contract: Original A/B/f, executed E, source/lifts, physical moments, native coordinates, trace maps and coefficients; no recomputed nullspace.
